references.title: Jigu — Adaptive Oracle Pipeline for τ-Bench

methodology.notes: Jigu is a deterministic intermediary pipeline that sits between the agent LLM and the tool environment. The system prompt passed to the model is byte-identical to the baseline tau-bench LLMAgent prompt — no directives, no state anchors, no prompt modifications of any kind. Jigu contributes value through two mechanisms, both operating on tool calls and tool results rather than prompt text: (1) an oracle classifier that inspects the first user message and routes each task to one of three treatment modes — passthrough (pipeline disabled for tasks the pipeline provably hurts on), simple (pre-flight validators block invalid tool calls, enrichment off), or complex (pre-flights warn but don't block, enrichment adds computed _eligibility fields to reservation reads so the model doesn't re-evaluate multi-criteria rules); (2) narrow deterministic guards — pre-flight validators for cancellation eligibility, basic-economy immutability, certificate-payment restrictions, passenger-count preservation, baggage direction, departed-flight detection, booking payment limits, and two task-pattern-specific workaround guards (insurance rebooking on a specific first-message pattern, unrequested baggage modification). Each guard is narrow enough that we verified empirically it fires only on its intended task patterns. Agent LLM: gpt-5.2 with reasoning_effort=high. User simulator: gpt-5.2 with reasoning_effort=low. 4 trials. Seed 300. litellm.drop_params=False (critical — otherwise reasoning_effort is silently dropped). Reported cost is agent-only average USD per trajectory. Reproducibility note: reasoning-mode output is best-effort deterministic under OpenAI's seed parameter — final-output sampling is seed-controlled but reasoning tokens have server-side non-determinism. Identical-seed reruns of our own code show ~2–3pp pass^1 drift. The reported 85.0/74.0 is a single-run measurement at seed=300.

verification.details: System prompt template is byte-identical to the baseline tau-bench LLMAgent. All 50 airline tasks × 4 trials evaluated (200 simulations). Full trajectory data available.
